findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 19 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 19.1 1, 19.2 1, 19.3 1, 19.4 4, 19.5 1, 19.6 2, 19.7 4, 19.8 2, 19.9 1, 19.9.1 6, 19.10 1.

Theory parts cover catenation, classification of hydrocarbons, functional groups, the parts of an IUPAC name, the classes of compounds and their names, types of formulae, reaction intermediates from bond fission, types of reagents, the seven reaction types, free radical and polar mechanisms, classification of isomers, polarimeter, chirality, enantiomers and racemic mixture, meso forms and 2ⁿ, restricted rotation, the condition for cis-trans isomerism and thalidomide. Two numericals (formulae from skeletal formulae and from general formulae) use new compounds, recomputed in Python. The exercise's own descriptive questions (homolysis vs heterolysis, cis-trans with two examples, optical activity, racemic vs meso) are not repeated. Book corrections followed (2-bromopropane, ethene, +δ carbon, KCN, 1-iodo-3-methylbutane, thalidomide re-marketed); the seven reaction types described and NH in secondary amines are standard chemistry, not book corrections.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
